sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 350. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% damage reflection for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 60 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 100 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
